metadata.description: CORE — project intelligence in chat with a critic baked in. The `/core` agent plus seven companion utilities.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: CORE — a project intelligence agent that knows your project across sessions, surfaces decisions and risks proactively, and challenges overconfidence. Type `/core` to start. Ships with seven companion utilities — `/orient`, `/finalize`, `/process-memory`, `/register-sources`, `/vibecheck`, `/organize-files`, `/configure-project` — that CORE invokes internally and that you can also call directly.
